DESCRIPTION: Found in the 2026-09-25 audit. SUMMARY: Gold token trio and GOLD repoint
USER_STORY: As a user, I want gold to mean loans, liabilities and pending everywhere, so the colour tells me something distinct from the selected tab.
DESCRIPTION: src/index.css, src/constants/colors.ts, tests/themeContrast.test.mjs [22a, 4b, 12a] README design tokens, LED-100 retro. ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA: (a) --gold exists in light and dark with @theme utilities; (b) GOLD resolves to var(--gold) and no longer aliases --primary; (c) tests/themeContrast.test.mjs asserts gold >= 3:1 against page and card surfaces and warning ink >= 4.5:1 on its tint in both themes; (d) tests/hardcodedColors.test.mjs still passes with no new hex or Tailwind palette literals; (e) the stale 'gold (--primary)' comments are corrected and a pattern note is added under knowledge/patterns; (f) lint, build and test pass.

SUMMARY: Contrast leftovers: Home legend, 13th Month dash, uncategorized grey, treemap labels
